analysis.title: EQ Technical Analysis - Bearish potential emerged in SAP
key_insights: S&P 500 short-term technical outlook moved to neutral from bullish. Spot ref 7549.94 (close 9 Nov) after slipping from 7580.07 on 2 Nov. It failed to hold above the Cloud, which rejected upside on 9 Nov. UBS says its prior bullish call was incorrect.

S&P 500 levels: a close below 7257.33 is needed for a bearish outlook. A rebound above the Cloud (resistance 7702.88) would revert to bullish, targeting 7829.00 (reached but not broken), then 8085.48.
Nasdaq Composite is bearish. It closed below 24,425.34 on 5 Nov. Spot ref 25,253.14 after falling from 25,437.00 on 2 Nov. UBS says its prior bullish call was incorrect.

Nasdaq targets are 23,976.84, then 22,920.66. Rebounds are viewed as corrective, with upside expected to be rejected at Cloud resistance of 26,764.58. A close above the Cloud would revert to bullish, targeting 27,548.13 then 28,367.97.
Hang Seng stays bearish with a target of 22,668.35. It rebounded from 23,441.63 to 24,573.83 and filled the 22 Oct gap-down. UBS expects the 5 Nov gap to be filled, i.e. a decline to 23,919.50.

Hang Seng has repeatedly failed to hold above the Cloud since January. UBS would turn only neutral on a break above the Cloud (resistance 24,962.47). A close above 26,836.66 is needed for a bullish outlook, targeting 28,056.10.

CSI 300 is bearish with spot ref 4064.07, rebounded from 4020.86. It is resisted by the 20d SMA at 4090.69. UBS flags rebound risk toward 4513.45 because of unfilled gap-downs on 24 and 26 Sep. That level is likely above the Cloud (resistance 4430.34) and could tilt it bullish.
CSI 300 bearish targets are 3829.25 then 3704.44, until bullish confirmation.

Nikkei 225 is bearish after closing below 59,332.43 on 6 Nov. Spot ref 60,424.22, down from 63,245.65 on 2 Nov, against UBS's rebound expectation. Targets are 54,487.32 then 52,636.87. Rebounds are corrective. A rebound above the Cloud (resistance 67,249.90) would revert to bullish, targeting 72,831.73.

EURO Stoxx 50 stays bearish on a completed head and shoulders top. Spot ref 6290.45, with a pattern target of 5811.16 then 5762.15. UBS tolerates rebounds to 6365.40, above which the pattern is invalid. A close above the Cloud (6373.84) is needed for bullish, targeting 6577.20.
Rheinmetall (UBS Buy, PT EUR 1,100) is bearish technically. Spot ref 845.90, down from 1030.40. The 933.00 target broke on 5 Nov. New targets are 774.60 then 661.60.

Rheinmetall is expected to rebound near term to correct the lower Bollinger overextension and fill the 5 Nov gap, i.e. to 945.50. A close above the Cloud (1073.03) would improve the upside bias, and a close above 1234.00 is needed for a bullish outlook, targeting 1352.50 then 1471.00.

SAP (UBS Neutral, PT EUR 210) keeps a bullish short-term technical outlook, with spot ref 211.85, but bearish potential has emerged from a rising wedge. Price rebounded without testing the upper Bollinger and downward momentum lingers.

SAP: breaking below the support trendline would complete the rising wedge, suggesting a decline of 42.29 from the breakdown point. Breaking above the resistance trendline invalidates the pattern. Bullish targets are 219.45 (reached but not broken) then 243.40.

market_movers.rationale: Rheinmetall carries a UBS Buy rating and EUR 1,100 PT. The technical outlook is bearish, with new targets of 774.60 and 661.60. It has no liquid US listing in this report.

The UBS rating is Neutral with a EUR 210 PT. The technical outlook is bullish above the Cloud, but a rising wedge shows bearish potential. A break below the support trendline would complete the pattern.

risk_factors: S&P 500 upside was rejected at the Cloud on 9 Nov, and UBS says its prior bullish call was wrong.
A CSI 300 rebound to 4513.45 could tilt it bullish and invalidate the bearish view.
A EURO Stoxx 50 move above 6365.40 would invalidate the head and shoulders pattern.
A SAP break above the resistance trendline would invalidate the rising wedge.
vol_and_positioning: S&P 500 was oversold below the lower Bollinger band on 6 Nov, followed by a corrective rebound.
Rheinmetall is overextended below the lower Bollinger with increased downward momentum, and a corrective rebound is expected.
CSI 300 has diverged from the lower Bollinger with increased upward momentum, so a near-term rebound is a risk.
